title: The Use of CO2 in Routine-Colonoscopy
brief_summary: In this double-blind, randomised and controlled study 150 Patients referred to colonoscopy were assigned to either CO2 or air insufflation. We recorded basic characteristics of colonoscopy and the amount of drugs used for sedation. Patients and investigators filled out questionnaires to record pain, abdominal bloating and flatulence.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* older than 18 years
* informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* former colonic resections
* severe heart or lung disease (NYHA III or IV)
* Pregnancy
* Patients with planned gastroscopy within 24 hours
